C1648.title: Financial Crime in the Web3 Metaverse: Money Laundering and Market Manipulation
C1648.summary: An academic study published in February 2023 systematically examines financial crime typologies within the Web3 metaverse ecosystem, including fraud, malicious attacks, money laundering, and illicit services.
